review.reason: The mapped course features and fairway stripes are clearly represented, but trees crowd the Hole 3 tee-to-fairway carry and make that route look obstructed in the overview.

issues.detail: Added tree crowns near the T3-to-fairway landing corridor crowd the apparent carry from the tee toward the first fairway section.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the Hole 3 tee shot appear obstructed and obscures the intended route.
